_about: Cost assumptions behind the GPU unit-economics panel. These are the argument, so they are printed on the chart and kept here where you can change them. capexPerGpu is the all-in server cost per accelerator (GPU plus its share of CPU, memory, networking, chassis), in dollars at launch-era pricing. tdpW is board power; the chart applies PUE and the electricity price below. launch is first volume shipment, used for the chip's age. Sources for the reference values: vendor and integrator list pricing as reported in trade press (Nvidia HGX/DGX, Supermicro, Dell), TDPs from vendor datasheets. Editable; the chart shows the reviewed date.

assumptions.referenceModelNote: OpenAI's open-weight 120B mixture-of-experts model, 1,024-token input and output, single-turn, FP4 where the hardware supports it. Chosen because InferenceX benchmarks it on every generation from Hopper to Blackwell and AMD, and OpenRouter prices it, so the same model gives throughput and a market price.
